name: Automated Employee Offboarding – Access Revocation + Verification

parameters.content:
## Automated Employee Offboarding System

Receives an offboarding request, revokes access across IAM, SaaS, IT and HR systems, then verifies that access has actually been removed before returning a final compliance report.

### All nodes (1-line each)
1. Webhook - Offboarding Request – Receives the employee offboarding payload via POST.
2. Code - Validate & Prepare – Validates the request and builds the revocation + verification payloads.
3. Wait - Pre IAM Revoke – Short pause before revoking identity access.
4. HTTP Request - IAM Revoke – Disables or deletes the user identity and removes group memberships.
5. Code - Process IAM Revoke – Records IAM revocation result and prepares the verification call.
6. Wait - Pre IAM Verify – Pause before verifying IAM revocation.
7. HTTP Request - IAM Verify – Checks that the user identity is disabled and has no active sessions.
8. Code - Process IAM Verify – Confirms IAM verification status.
9. Wait - Pre SaaS Revoke – Pause before SaaS access revocation.
10. HTTP Request - SaaS Revoke – Removes the user from Slack, Google Workspace, GitHub and other apps.
11. Code - Process SaaS Revoke – Records SaaS revocation results.
12. Wait - Pre SaaS Verify – Pause before SaaS verification.
13. HTTP Request - SaaS Verify – Confirms the user no longer has active access in SaaS systems.
14. Code - Process SaaS Verify – Confirms SaaS verification status.
15. Wait - Pre IT & HR – Pause before IT and HR finalization.
16. HTTP Request - IT & HR Finalize – Disables email, closes device tickets and updates HR status.
17. Code - Build Final Report – Aggregates all revocation and verification results into a compliance report.
18. Code - Finalize Response – Assembles the final offboarding status for the caller.
19. Respond to Webhook – Returns the complete offboarding + verification report.

## 1. Intake & IAM Revoke + Verify

Webhook - Offboarding Request – Receives the employee offboarding payload via POST.
Code - Validate & Prepare – Validates the request and builds the revocation + verification payloads.
Wait - Pre IAM Revoke – Short pause before revoking identity access.
HTTP Request - IAM Revoke – Disables or deletes the user identity and removes group memberships.
Code - Process IAM Revoke – Records IAM revocation result and prepares the verification call.
Wait - Pre IAM Verify – Pause before verifying IAM revocation.
HTTP Request - IAM Verify – Checks that the user identity is disabled and has no active sessions.
Code - Process IAM Verify – Confirms IAM verification status.

## 2. SaaS Revoke + Verify

Wait - Pre SaaS Revoke – Pause before SaaS access revocation.
HTTP Request - SaaS Revoke – Removes the user from Slack, Google Workspace, GitHub and other apps.
Code - Process SaaS Revoke – Records SaaS revocation results.
Wait - Pre SaaS Verify – Pause before SaaS verification.
HTTP Request - SaaS Verify – Confirms the user no longer has active access in SaaS systems.
Code - Process SaaS Verify – Confirms SaaS verification status.

## 3. IT / HR & Finish

Wait - Pre IT & HR – Pause before IT and HR finalization.
HTTP Request - IT & HR Finalize – Disables email, closes device tickets and updates HR status.
Code - Build Final Report – Aggregates all revocation and verification results into a compliance report.
Code - Finalize Response – Assembles the final offboarding status for the caller.
Respond to Webhook – Returns the complete offboarding + verification report.
